response.sql: SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, per_day_rental_price, per_day_rental_price / AVG(per_day_rental_price) OVER () AS relative_to_rating_mean FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_rental_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS rating_averages ORDER BY rating
